history.summary: Large 1,442sqft 3BR at Braddell MRT (280m), $2.4M / $1,664psf — a striking ~15% below the URA median ($1,967). Generous size, two-MRT access and a responsive MCST make this an efficient, well-priced D12 hold; the discount reflects the bay-window/balcony-heavy layout rather than a defect.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,664psf vs $1,967 URA median is a ~15% discount — the standout value in this batch on an absolute-PSF basis, driven by the large 1,442sqft format (price-per-foot compresses on big units). 134 transactions = liquid, reliable; 5.64%/yr CAGR is healthy. 280m to Braddell NS18 plus Toa Payoh within reach is a real transit/rental anchor. Reviews note responsive MCST and good maintenance. Caveats: $2.4M sits at the upper edge of the liquid band, and reviews flag thin soundproofing and bay-window/balcony space that inflates strata area — partly why PSF reads cheap. Net: large, central, MRT-fronting, fairly-to-cheaply priced. MMR 746 / on frontier supports.
red_flags: Reviews cite poor soundproofing between units
Bay windows / large balconies inflate strata area (PSF flatters the layout)
$2.4M near the top of the liquid price band; 99yr leasehold
catalysts: ~15% below URA median PSF — genuine value for a large 3BR
280m to Braddell MRT plus second-MRT access (Toa Payoh) — strong liquidity
1,442sqft generous family layout broadens resale buyer pool
